title: GFG: Detect Loop in Linked List
description: Given a list `next_ptrs` where `next_ptrs[i]` is the next node index from node `i` (-1 indicating null termination), return `True` if the linked list contains a cycle, `False` otherwise.
explanation: Floyd's cycle-finding algorithm uses slow and fast pointers to detect loops in O(N) time and O(1) space.
